events.text: Goal! Brentford 1, Chelsea 0. Jaidon Anthony (Brentford) header from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Jannik Schuster with a headed pass following a corner.
Substitution, Brentford. Aaron Hickey replaces Michael Kayode.
Substitution, Brentford. Mamadou Sangaré replaces Yehor Yarmoliuk.
Substitution, Chelsea. Geovany Quenda replaces Danny Welbeck.
Substitution, Chelsea. Josh Acheampong replaces Wesley Fofana.
Substitution, Brentford. Dango Ouattara replaces Jaidon Anthony.
Substitution, Brentford. El Hadji Malick Diouf replaces Keane Lewis-Potter.
Goal! Brentford 2, Chelsea 0. Igor Thiago (Brentford) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner following a fast break.
Igor Thiago (Brentford) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Mamadou Sangaré (Brentford) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chelsea. Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli replaces Valentín Barco.
Substitution, Chelsea. Estêvão replaces Pedro Neto.
Substitution, Brentford. Fábio Carvalho replaces Mikkel Damsgaard.
Goal! Brentford 3, Chelsea 0. Fábio Carvalho (Brentford) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the top right corner.
